verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so AMD GPU acceleration through Vulkan is a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents Qualcomm Hexagon NPU and Apple Metal (MetalRT) acceleration, plus a generic 'whatever silicon the device has' slogan. Nothing mentions a Vulkan backend, AMD GPUs, or running without ROCm.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
